practice_questions.question_text: A clinic stores Patient(PatientID, Name) and Condition(PatientID, ConditionCode, Notes). A patient may have many conditions. Explain why separate condition rows are preferable to Condition1, Condition2,… columns, and how a database view can limit what reception staff see.
